purpose: Natural English dataset questions for model-facing tool selection and optional FlyDelta observation.

model_contract.selection: Choose exactly one most-specific read-only dataset tool. Return only {"name":"tool.name","arguments":{...}}.
model_contract.dataset_rule: Use the canonical dataset reference dataset://local/sales when a dataset argument is required.
model_contract.learning_rule: A model selection is only an observation. A FlyDelta learning example requires a separate host-verified repair or counterfactual.
